name: lkjstr
description: Browser frontend and Rust/WASM Worker engine. See AGENTS.md.

scripts.check:repo: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p lkjstr-xtask -- quiet repo
scripts.test:quiet: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p lkjstr-xtask -- quiet test
scripts.rust-wasm:quiet: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p lkjstr-xtask -- quiet rust-wasm
scripts.verify:quiet: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p lkjstr-xtask -- quiet verify
scripts.ci:quiet: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p lkjstr-xtask -- quiet ci
